title: Toby the Puppy & The Broken Flowerpot: Why Truth Wins!

lines.text: Toby the puppy was chasing his bouncy tennis ball through the sunny kitchen!
lines.caps: Toby the puppy was *CHASING | his bouncy tennis ball through the *SUNNY | *KITCHEN!

lines.text: Crash! His tail knocked Grandma's favorite yellow flowerpot right off the table!

lines.text: When Grandma rushed in, Toby panicked and said, A giant monster did it!

lines.text: Grandma looked worried, but Toby's tummy felt tied in an uncomfortable knot!

lines.text: Lies feel heavy, like carrying a sharp stone in your shoe all day long!
